title: 3D Scanner: Sapling
tagline: Photogrammetry & LiDAR scanning for iOS, macOS, and Apple Vision Pro
description: Make 3D models for augmented reality, 3D printing, game development, or simply sharing with friends.

It performs photogrammetry on images with LIDAR enabled scanning, or you can use AI generate objects from text. Export in a variety of 3D quality, including high-end textures. All photogrammetry processing happens on your device!

features.heading: Features
items: Export in USDZ, OBJ, STL, and PLY formats

features.heading: Compatibility
items: Apple Vision Pro: Requires visionOS 2.0 or later

privacy: At Cephalopod Studio, we take your privacy seriously. 3D Scanner: Sapling does not collect any user data. All processing happens locally on your device.

The app does not require an account, does not track your usage patterns, and does not send any information to our servers or third parties. Your 3D models and scans remain completely private and under your control at all times.
This app complies with Apple's App Privacy standards and has disclosed to Apple that it does not collect any user data.

title: Cannot Ignore
description: Never miss another important moment. Cannot Ignore delivers full-screen alarms designed specifically for those critical, one-time events that demand your full attention.

When your alarm fires, Cannot Ignore takes over your entire screen with unmissable alerts. Import events from Calendar or Reminders with automatic link detection for video conferences, set custom alarm sounds, and access meeting links instantly when alarms fire.
Perfect for crucial meetings, appointments, flight departures, and deadlines you absolutely cannot afford to miss.

features.heading: Unmissable Alerts
items: Full-screen alarms that take over your device
Custom audio file support for unique alarm sounds
Real-time alarm status updates with color-coded icons

features.heading: Smart Integration
items: Import from Calendar events with automatic link detection
Import from Reminders with automatic link detection
Detects video conference links (Zoom, Meet, Teams)
One-tap access to links when alarms fire
Automatically includes event notes and URLs

privacy: At Cephalopod Studio, your privacy comes first. Cannot Ignore is designed with privacy at its core.
No Data Collected: The developer does not collect any data from this app.
No Third-Party Tracking: We do not use any third-party trackers or analytics.
Your Data Stays Yours: Your alarms and settings remain private on your devices.
Local Storage Only: All alarm data is stored locally using iOS AlarmKit.
Calendar and Reminders access is used only for the import feature and no data leaves your device.

title: Director's Cut
tagline: AI-powered video editing from the command line. One prompt, one command, one finished video with narration and subtitles.
description: Raw footage in. Finished video out.
featuresHeading: Everything you need, nothing you don't

features.heading: Prompt-Driven Editing
items: Describe the video you want in plain English. The AI selects clips, sequences them, adds transitions, and renders your timeline.

features.heading: AI Narration
items: Auto-generated voiceover scripts timed to your video. Use cloud TTS or clone your own voice locally with Chatterbox — your voice data never leaves your machine.

features.heading: Animated Subtitles
items: TikTok-style word-by-word subtitles with precise timing. Multiple styles to match your content.

features.heading: Transparent Decisions
items: Every edit decision is saved as readable, editable JSON. Tweak the timeline by hand and re-render instantly — no AI call needed.

features.heading: Batch Production
items: Run the same footage with 10 different prompts to get 10 unique videos. A/B test edits at scale without touching a timeline.

features.heading: NLE Export
items: Export rough cuts as OpenTimelineIO for finishing in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro.

extraSections.heading: Made with Sapling footage
paragraphs: Real videos generated from raw Sapling screen recordings with a single command.
items: Image-to-3D AI Generation — Generating 3D models from images using AI, narrated and edited automatically.
Multi-Object Comparison — Multiple scanned objects compared in a single narrated video.
Getting Started Tutorial — An auto-generated how-to tutorial from raw screen recordings.

extraSections.heading: Terminal demo
items: -p "Create a 30-second product demo with upbeat narration" \

extraSections.heading: Get started in 30 seconds
paragraphs: No Python install needed — everything is bundled. Just Homebrew and a free Gemini API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey).

extraSections.heading: How it works
items: 1. Point it at your footage — Pass a folder of raw clips. Director's Cut detects scenes, transcribes speech, and builds a visual understanding of every shot.
2. Describe what you want — Write a prompt: "30-second product demo with narration" or "highlight reel of the best action shots." The AI makes the editorial decisions.
3. Get a finished video — Out comes a rendered MP4 with transitions, narration, and subtitles. Publish directly to YouTube or TikTok, or export to your NLE for final polish.

extraSections.heading: Built for people who'd rather ship than scrub timelines
paragraphs: 3 free video generations to try before you buy.
items: Content Creators — Batch-produce TikToks, Reels, and Shorts from a single shoot. Run the same footage 10 times with different prompts, pick the best one.
Developers & PMs — Turn screen recordings into polished product demos. No timeline scrubbing. No drag-and-drop. Just a prompt and an MP4.
Agencies & Marketing — Generate rough cuts in seconds, then hand off to your editor via OTIO export. A/B test video edits without multiplying production time.
Educators — Auto-narrate lecture footage, add subtitles for accessibility, and publish directly — all from one command.

extraSections.heading: Pricing
paragraphs: No subscription. No per-minute pricing. All future updates included.
items: 3 free video generations to try first

extraSections.heading: Requirements
items: Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4)

description: Rambler is a hands-free journaling app that lets you capture your thoughts out loud during walks, commutes, or chores. All transcription happens on-device using iOS 26 APIs, keeping your private reflections truly private.

items: Export entries individually or in bulk

privacy: At Cephalopod Studio, we take your privacy seriously. All transcription in Rambler happens entirely on-device using iOS 26 APIs. Your private reflections stay on your device.
Optional AI features (summaries, titles, mood detection) can be completely disabled for a 100% private experience. When enabled, these features also run on-device whenever possible.

The iOS Journal API integration preserves privacy by design—you must manually select memories and activities through Apple's journaling suggestions picker. We cannot access this data without your explicit action.
Your data is yours. Export your entries and attachments anytime, in full.

title: ToDon't
description: A to-do list filled with things to NOT do! Have fun with playful effects & feel productive, and, of course, add actual things to do onto the list for your real tasks!

Add random, pre-made tasks to your daily to-do list, specifically of things to NOT do, so that you can scratch them off and immediately feel productive while having fun. All of your tasks can sync to all of your devices via a shared ToDon't list in the Reminders app. The app has dozens and dozens of things to not do!
